title: 月圓鬼市贖魂
style_en: Late Qing dynasty Jiangnan mountain ghost market, moonlit night, misty lanterns, eerie melancholy atmosphere

world.place: 江南山城外，只在月圓夜出現的鬼市
world.extra: 鬼市用記憶當錢，賣掉的記憶再也回不來
world.goal: 在天亮前從鬼市贖回妹妹失去的魂魄

protagonist.name: 小滿
protagonist.profile: 山城藥舖的學徒，妹妹昨夜突然失了魂

characters.name: 青蘿
characters.appearance: 外表 18 歲的狐仙少女，及腰墨綠色長髮，金色豎瞳，頭上一對白色狐耳，淺綠色交領襦裙，腰間繫紅繩鈴鐺
characters.personality: 狡黠愛捉弄人，其實心軟
characters.relationship: 鬼市的引路人，對主角的藥香很好奇
characters.appearance_en: 18-year-old fox spirit girl, waist-length dark green hair, golden vertical pupils, white fox ears, light green cross-collar ruqun, red string bell at waist

characters.name: 老墨
characters.appearance: 看不出年紀的瘦高男子，灰白長髮用木簪束起，戴半張黑色面具，深紫色長袍，手持算盤
characters.speech: 惜字如金，開口就是價錢
characters.relationship: 鬼市掌櫃，收著妹妹的魂
characters.appearance_en: Ageless tall thin man, gray-white long hair tied with wooden hairpin, half black mask, deep purple robe, holding abacus

ghost_market_entrance.name: 鬼市入口
ghost_market_entrance.image_prompt: Ancient stone archway entrance to ghost market, full moon night, thick mist, dim lanterns glowing faintly, moss-covered stone path, shadowy stalls receding into darkness

ghost_market_inner.name: 鬼市深處
ghost_market_inner.image_prompt: narrow stone alley in a supernatural night market, dim paper lanterns glowing faintly, mist swirling around wooden stalls selling memories in glass bottles, cobblestone pavement, moonlight filtering through fog, eerie but quiet atmosphere

locker_third_floor.name: 鎖魂櫃第三層
locker_third_floor.image_prompt: ancient chinese underground vault, stone corridors lined with iron cabinets, dim blue phosphorescent fireflies, cold mist, pre-dawn darkness, eerie silence
